title: Existence of the etale residue triples ring colimit
statement: Let $R$ be a commutative ring, $p\in\operatorname{Spec}R$, and $K$ a separable closure of $\kappa(p)$ with prescribed algebra map $\chi:\kappa(p)\to K$. Let $\mathcal T$ be the category of etale residue triples [def-weil-pbc-etale-residue-triples], and $D:\mathcal T\to\mathrm{CommRing}$ its ring diagram. There exist a colimit cocone $c$ of $D$, a ring map $\rho:R\to c$, and a ring map $\psi:c\to K$, such that for every triple $t=(B,\alpha,q,\phi)$, $\iota_t\circ\alpha=\rho$ and $\psi\circ\iota_t$ is the canonical composite $B\to\kappa(q)\xrightarrow{\phi}K$.

source.place: Tag 04GW (lemma-strict-henselization-different), colimit in the statement; Mathlib Scheme.AffineEtale.instEssentiallySmall and CommRingCat.hasColimits_commRingCat for size and existence

proof.text: Send a triple to its canonical arrow B to K from the opposite affine etale category over Spec R. The functor is fully faithful: its inverse on morphisms takes the underlying ring map, recovers R-compatibility by injectivity of Spec.map, and uses the costructured-arrow equation for K-compatibility. Mathlib CostructuredArrow.essentiallySmall and essentiallySmall_of_fully_faithful now give essential smallness of triples.

Apply HasColimitsOfShape.of_essentiallySmall to the triples category and CommRingCat.hasColimits_commRingCat to get the colimit cocone and its universal property. The local-smallness instance is inferred for the induced under-over category.
The identity triple t0 has a morphism to each triple t given by its structural map alpha. Set rho equal to the coprojection at t0; cocone naturality gives iota_t composed with alpha = rho.

The morphism equations in the under-over category say exactly that the composites B to kappa(q) to K are a cocone. Descend this cocone through IsColimit to obtain psi; its factorization equations give the second compatibility for every t.

proof_origin: Stacks Tag 04GW; Mathlib affine etale essential smallness, costructured-arrow essential smallness, and ring colimits. M2 formalizes the fully faithful embedding of triples into pointed affine etale rings, then constructs rho by identity-triple naturality and psi by descent of the K-valued cocone.

lean.statement: theorem etaleResidueTriples_exists_colimit_part (R : CommRingCat.{u}) (p : Spec R) (K : Type u) [Field K] [Algebra ((Spec R).residueField p) K] [IsSepClosure ((Spec R).residueField p) K] : ∃ c : Cocone (etaleResidueTriplesRingDiagram R p K (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap ((Spec R).residueField p) K))), Nonempty (IsColimit c) ∧ ∃ (ρ : R ⟶ c.pt) (ψ : c.pt →+* K), (∀ t, t.α ≫ c.ι.app t = ρ) ∧ (∀ t, ψ.comp (c.ι.app t).hom = ((ΓSpecIso t.B).inv ≫ (Spec t.B).Γevaluation t.q ≫ t.φ).hom)
